notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/sega/nl_astrob.cpp (NETLIST_START(astrob), CC0-1.0, Aaron Giles) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/astrob-sound.nets.

Undone beyond the switches: twenty resistors in the sonar circuit that MAME multiplies by 1.001-1.049 (its comment: the circuit 'relies on subtle part differences') are written at their nominal value; and ENABLE_SONAR_ALT, which adds four 1M resistors to a 0.1V source to start the oscillators, is off.

Compared with the sound board sheets, Astro Blaster Sound 800-3122 rev B sheets 7 and 8 of 8 (doc 7c9390526e01 pp57-58, the 300 dpi scan read at up to 5x), and with its parts list (pp33, 35-36), 2026-10-20. Every resistor and capacitor value in MAME's file (R1-R186, C1-C82) and every IC, diode and transistor type agrees with the parts list, quantities included; the sonar resistors MAME scales are the list's nominal values. The sheets agree with MAME net for net and pin for pin, diode and transistor orientation included, in the latch outputs and their 7406/7407 buffers (U26, U29-U31); the four sonar oscillators (U1, U2) and their trigger (U11, D2, Q1-Q3, U7A); both lasers (U25, U24/U19, U20/U14, the real VCO branch); refill (U3, U4, U5, Q7) and attack, rate reset and warp (U21, U15, D14-D23, U16B); explosions (U27, U21, U8, Q6, U16A/C) and astroids (U16D, Q5, U7C); the four invaders (U22, U23/U18/Q8, U13/U12, U17, U37/U28/U38) and bonus (U10, U6); and the summing bus (R98-R103, R118-R122, C55).

Corrected from the sheets: the four oscillators MAME runs as ideal clocks are CD4011 RC oscillators (U9 with R18/C3 and R46/C20, U11 with R22/C5, U10 with R80/C35), on exactly the gates MAME parks, and they are put back. MAME's "unconnected" U7 pins are the output stage: pin 12 is grounded, pin 13 is the summing node (now joined to it), and pins 5-7 are the mute comparator, which with Q4 is what MAME's mute function stands in for.

Sheet misprints, MAME right: U2's first output is printed "4", and U38's supply pin "5". Not in this file: the rest of the output stage (U7D's feedback, C58, Q4, D13, R115-R117, R123, R124, R135, R141-R144, C48, P1), the port decoder and latches U32-U36, and the power decoupling.
conflicts: The sonar trigger's 1K (MAME's R117) is printed "R119 1K". The same sheet prints R119 470K in the mixer and an R117 1K in the mute circuit, and the parts list's 1K entry carries an R19 that neither sheet prints, so it is probably R19. This file keeps MAME's R117, which names a different resistor on the board.
Q5 and Q6 (2N4093): the sheet labels S on the signal node and D on ground. MAME swaps them on purpose ("D and S swapped on schematics???"). This file follows MAME.
The attack capacitor is printed "C69 .05uf", a second C69 beside the explosion's 4.7uF C69. MAME's C67 is what the parts list's counts allow.
